constants.window: periodic Hann 4096: w[n] = 0.5 - 0.5 cos(2 pi n / 4096)

mix.desc: standardised 44.1 kHz stereo chunk, exactly 343980 samples (zero-padded)

spec.desc: STFT of mix, CaC layout [Re L, Im L, Re R, Im R] x 2048 bins (Nyquist dropped) x 336 frames

spec_out.desc: per source (drums, bass, other, vocals) CaC spectrogram, same layout as spec

wave_out.desc: per source time-branch waveform; stems = istft(spec_out) + wave_out

preprocessing.decode: stereo float32 at 44.1 kHz (ffmpeg -ac 2 -ar 44100 -f f32le in Python); mono files are duplicated to 2 channels
preprocessing.standardise: ref = mean of the 2 channels; mean = ref.mean(); std = ref.std(ddof=1) + 1e-8 (torch unbiased std over the whole song); mix_std = (mix - mean) / std
preprocessing.chunks: offsets = 0, 257985, 515970, ... while offset < N (stride = int(0.75 * 343980)); chunk length L = min(N - offset, 343980); if L < 343980 the chunk is CENTRED in the 343980 window: start = offset - (343980 - L)//2, samples before 0 / after N are zeros (demucs TensorChunk.padded)
preprocessing.stft: per channel of the 343980 chunk: (1) reflect-pad 1536 on the left and 1536 + 84 = 1620 on the right (-> 347136 = 1536 + 336*1024 + 1536); (2) reflect-pad 2048 on both sides (torch.stft center=True); (3) 340 frames x[1024 j : 1024 j + 4096] * hann4096; (4) rfft -> 2049 bins, divide by 64; (5) keep frames 2..337 (336) and bins 0..2047 (drop Nyquist); (6) spec[2c] = Re, spec[2c+1] = Im

postprocessing.istft: per source s, channel c: Z = spec_out[s, 2c] + i spec_out[s, 2c+1] (2048 x 336); append a zero Nyquist row (2049 bins) and 2 zero frames on each side (340 frames); for each frame j: y_j = irfft(Z[:, j], n=4096) * 64 * hann4096 (torch.istft normalized=True multiplies by sqrt(n_fft)); overlap-add y_j at 1024 j into a 351232 buffer and hann4096^2 into an envelope buffer; divide by the envelope; drop 2048 samples at both ends (center=True, length 347136); stem = y[1536 : 1536 + 343980]
postprocessing.overlap_add: res = stem_chunk[..., (343980 - L)//2 : (343980 - L)//2 + L] (center_trim); out[offset : offset + L] += w[:L] * res; sum_w[offset : offset + L] += w[:L]; w = concat(1..171990, 171990..1) / 171990 (triangle, transition_power 1); stems = out / sum_w
postprocessing.unstandardise: stems = stems * std + mean (the mix statistics above)
postprocessing.downstream: stems16[s] = resample(stems[s].mean(channels), 44100 -> 16000) (soxr HQ in Python); then the per-stem log-mel (librosa n_fft 1024, win 400, hop 320, 80 mels, slaney, ln(mel + 1e-6)), onset strength and RMS of analysis-spec.md section 4 — the same mel code must be used for all 4 stems; the mix mel is never used by the tokens
postprocessing.shifts: song.py uses shifts=1 (one random shift in [0, 22050] samples, unseeded); the port uses shifts=0, so stems differ from any Python dump at the level of a random shift (parity/index.json: correlation >= 0.99)
